description: TASK-F10 band-decision evidence, produced offline by scripts/jev_band_sweep.py from the committed TASK-F09 balanced-corpus Jev scores (197 cases per run). No model calls, no credentials, no project id. The sweep is tuned on a deterministic half of run1 and reported on the held-out half of BOTH runs as a replicate check. This is evidence for a maintainer decision, NOT a band change: FR-02 still requires fresh labeled evidence and a same-change sync before any edge moves.

runs.purpose: Sweep candidate clear-low / clear-high edges over committed Jev P values; select on tune half, report on held-out halves of both runs.

method.selection: among candidates with zero false positives on the tune half, maximize decided accuracy, then minimize escalation, then prefer edges closest to the shipped 0.35/0.75

headline.tradeoff: Lowering the edges cuts below-edge misses from 38 to 11 on held-out cases with no new benign blocks, but roughly doubles Tier-2 escalation from ~6% to ~14% (the metric is Tier-1 decided accuracy; escalation is the Tier-2 call share).

options_for_maintainer: Lower the edges (indicative selection 0.08 / 0.40) — best attack capture, highest Tier-2 load.
Keep 0.35 / 0.75 and add threat-intelligence backing for IOC-type calls (9 below-edge IOC-type attacks in the full balanced corpus).
Accept the 38 misses and leave the band unchanged.
caveats: Tier-1 Jev scores only — no full-firewall verdicts or end-to-end catch-rate claim.
Tuned on one half and reported on the other, but still a single corpus and a single model release (jev-1.14.0).
Track G (FR-09 question/state redesign) is PLANNED; it would invalidate this evidence if it lands first.
Any band change needs a spec amendment with fresh labeled evidence and a same-change sync of AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/ and .greptile/.
